name: domainenum
description: Domain discovery, both halves: local domain posture, DC location (logon server / DNS SRV), and the anonymous LDAP root DSE; and over an authenticated LDAP bind, domain users, groups, ACLs, SPN objects, and trusts -- recon.domainenum's execution half packed as the artifact an implant loads through module.load.

opsec.notes: Server side, the package lands as descriptor rows and one artifact file under the module store -- no code runs in the teamserver. On the target, the implant half loads from staged task content: through a memfd on Linux (nothing on disk), mapped in memory on Windows. The sweep sends DNS and LDAP packets to the domain's own servers -- network-visible to the DC. The authenticated scopes bind with the task's credential over simple bind on the cleartext port: the secret crosses the implant-to-DC path in the open unless the site seals it, and a wrong password counts toward the account's lockout.
